text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I thought I heard someone call me 
just now...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...There's no one here after all. Just the 
statue of the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of statues, I used to sing and 
dance all the time in that plaza with the 
bronze statue by Tomakomai Station.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, this takes me right back to when 
I first started out as a local idol...
